packaging_difference: Use actual host shared libzstd.so.1 and libxml2.so.2; upstream build-host staticzstd path and unversionedXML link file are absent. Preserve this distinction in performance attribution.
interpretation: This is a locally relinked subset of official LLVM23.1.4 component archives, not an upstream-prebuilt monolithic DSO.
The official shlib recipe supports explicit component selection and whole-archive retention. Its helper source libllvm.cpp is empty.
X86 components must retain ELF and COFF target-machine behavior; source selection and successful target lookup are not full code-generation acceptance.
Shared zstd is supported upstream, but replacing the package's static-zstd build-host path with a host DSO changes the dependency/linkage profile and must remain disclosed.
Do not attribute a compiler performance difference to LLVM version alone without recording this packaging and runtime dependency closure.
No new ABI ownership relaxation or unsafe fallback is justified by this packaging route.
